collection.description: An experienced adult struggles with a familiar task after a recent injury and resents being treated as helpless.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (adult), an experienced adult, struggles with a familiar task after a recent injury and resents being treated as helpless.

choices.label: Ask What Assistance They Actually Want

text_only.reason: health or an injury in the story (the event's premise or a word in passing); nobody's health changes -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They request help carrying supplies but keep control of the task.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They decline assistance today and appreciate that their decision is respected.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A lower work surface makes the task manageable again.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The first arrangement is awkward, so (adult) suggests a better layout.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (adult) enjoys teaching an apprentice while recovering.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They miss hands-on work and negotiate a safe gradual return.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: They admit that needing help has shaken their confidence.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They explain that unsolicited pity hurts more than the practical difficulty.
